items.title: SoftBank acquires Marc Raibert’s Robotics and AI Institute
items.summary: SoftBank has completed its acquisition of the Robotics and AI Institute from Hyundai Motor Group, expanding its robotics portfolio as the research organization looks to fill 24 open positions in Massachusetts and Switzerland.The post SoftBank acquires Marc Raibert’s Robotics and AI Institute appeared first on The Robot Report.
items.creator: Steve Crowe
